constitutional_rule: KORA Contribution is a companion indicator. It is NOT a KORA Index component. It must never be added to the KORA Index computation or displayed as an 11th component. Every record carries is_kora_index_component: false.
companion_label_global: KORA Contribution measures verified collective contribution beyond the company perimeter. It complements the KORA Index — it does not replace it.

data.contribution_explanation: In the full Q1–Q4 2025 period, Meridiana Group has activated collective contribution across four initiatives. The cross-company Bergamo Solidarity Network (jointly with Communitas Cooperativa) achieved 28 verified participations in the IMPACT pillar. The Legacy Knowledge Bridge completed advisor-validated knowledge transfer. Two further initiatives are active in GROWTH and LIFE pillars. Four ecosystem partners are now active. KORA Contribution has advanced from minimal to an emerging level — demonstrating that the company's impact is beginning to extend beyond internal activation into verified collective and ecosystem engagement.
